text: dsh-remote 是面向 DSH 的 SSH 远程工作区插件，提供 Web、Desktop 与 TUI 使用入口。它把远程目录映射为本机镜像，并将会话绑定到对应主机和工作区。功能包括管理多台 SSH 主机、浏览及读写远端文件、在远端执行命令和搜索、双向冲突感知同步，以及端口转发和远端 DSH 网页附加。适合需要在 DSH 中维护远程开发环境、跨主机处理项目文件的开发者。需要可 SSH 登录的远程主机；默认使用内置 SSH，亦可选择本机 OpenSSH。

dsh-remote connects SSH hosts to DSH workspaces on Web, Desktop, and TUI. It manages machines, browses remote files, runs commands and searches, syncs conflict-aware local mirrors, forwards ports, and opens remote DSH web interfaces. It requires an SSH-accessible host.

我想在本机编辑远程项目，再把改动同步回服务器。
需要从 DSH 里查看远端目录、读文件和修改文件。
怎样在远程主机上跑命令，并搜索项目里的代码？
我想用 SSH 隧道访问远程服务的端口。
I want to work on an SSH server project from a DSH workspace.
Can I sync a remote project to a local mirror and push edits back without silently overwriting conflicts?
dsh-remote 的功能「SSH 主机连接」：保存并切换多台 SSH 主机，支持使用 ssh-config 主机别名、跳板机及不同认证方式；连接后可选择远程工作区。
dsh-remote 的功能「远程工作区镜像」：验证远端目录后创建本地镜像，供 DSH 会话作为工作区使用；可通过同步工具拉取远端文件。
dsh-remote 的功能「远端文件管理」：通过 SFTP 列目录、查看属性、分页读取文件，并直接创建、追加、编辑、移动或删除远端文件。
dsh-remote 的功能「远程命令执行」：在当前工作区或指定目录运行远端 shell 命令，可选择 PTY、设置超时，或返回后台任务编号。
dsh-remote 的功能「远端内容搜索」：按正则搜索远端文件，支持文件名 glob、大小写选项和上下文行；扫描受文件数与时长限制。
dsh-remote 的功能「双向镜像同步」：rw_sync 下载、rw_push 上传本地镜像；按上次同步状态识别两端冲突，并提供预演和强制覆盖选项。
dsh-remote 的功能「SSH 端口转发」：创建本地或反向转发定义，并通过 SSH 隧道连接目标主机和端口；设置可在连接时恢复。
dsh-remote 的功能「远程 DSH 网页附加」：经 SSH 在本机浏览器打开远端 DSH 网页，可附加已有实例或启动新实例并建立本地转发。
dsh-remote 的功能「终端远程 shell」：在 DSH 终端的 shell 选项中加入 remote ssh 启动器，让用户通过 SSH 进入远端交互式 shell。
dsh-remote 的功能「管理界面与 TUI 工作区选择」：在设置页管理主机、选择目录，并可在 dsh-tui 注册远程管理场景、命令和工作区 provider。
dsh-remote 会向配置的心跳端点发送安装标识哈希、插件版本、平台、架构与 Node 版本；端点可由 DSH_REMOTE_HEARTBEAT_URL 覆盖。
使用远端网页附加功能时，插件会调用远端配置的 dsh 命令启动或连接网页实例；远程机器需提供可用的 DSH 命令。

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_info：Show the remote environment: host/user/port, connection health, current remote workspace path, active port forwards. Call this first to orient, or when an rw_* call fails to check connectivity. Note: remote context is session-scoped — a saved machine only becomes active when you explicitly rw_connect to it (issue #13).

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_connect：Connect SSH to a remote host for remote workspace work. Two ways (issue #48): (1) pass machineId to connect with a machine ALREADY SAVED in the registry (list them with rw_machines) — every stored setting applies: password/keychain password, privateKeyPath + passphrase, useAgent, keyboardInteractive, proxy, hostKeyMode, backend, and ~/.ssh/config aliases; or (2) pass host plus any of username/port/password/privateKeyPath/passphrase/useAgent/keyboardInteractive/hostKeyMode/backend/name. Defaults to saving the machine to the registry (save=false keeps it as a temporary connection). Once connected, call rw_pick_workspace to pick the workspace directory this session should work in. With useSshConfig=true, `host` is an ALIAS from ~/.ssh/config and every value (HostName/user/port/IdentityFile/ProxyJump) is read from that file at connect time. For a host that only accepts GSSAPI/Kerberos (issue #51), pass backend="openssh" (with useSshConfig=true) so the local ssh — which holds your…

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_machines：List the machines saved in the registry, secrets stripped: id, name, host/port/username, auth method flags, ssh-config alias resolution, workspace, grouping labels (environment / tags / location), and which one is current. Optional filters (environment / tags / location / query) narrow the list - useful once you have many machines. Pass rw_connect(machineId=<id>) to connect with the full stored settings of a machine (issue #48).

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_pick_workspace：Set the remote workspace directory this session should treat as its working root on the connected remote. Verifies it exists (a directory). Use rw_list_dir to browse first if unsure. Accepts POSIX (/home/dev/project) or Windows (C:\Users\dev\project) paths.

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_sync：Download the current remote workspace into its local mirror directory over SFTP (bounded, three-way conflict-aware). Makes the remote files visible/editable locally so the DSH native workspace / fs tools can operate on them. Conflicts (both sides modified) are reported and never overwritten; use force=true to override.

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_push：Upload the local mirror of the current remote workspace back to the remote host over SFTP (bounded, three-way conflict-aware). Use after editing files in the local mirror so the remote reflects your changes. Conflicts (both sides modified) are reported and never overwritten; use force=true to override.

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_list_dir：List a remote directory (or a single file) via SSH. Path is absolute; accepts Windows paths like C:\Users\dev\project on Git Bash remotes. If omitted, lists the current remote workspace. Shows type, size, mtime.
dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_stat：Show detailed stat of a remote file or directory: type, size, mtime, mode (SFTP attrs). Use to verify a remote path exists or to compare files.
dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_read_file：Read a text file on the remote host with line numbers. Supports paging with startLine/endLine and an encoding param (utf-8 default, gbk etc). Path is absolute.

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_write_file：Write text to a file on the remote host (creating parent directories if needed). Path is absolute. Use this to create or overwrite a remote file directly, instead of round-tripping through a local mirror.

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_edit：Edit a remote text file by replacing literal text (read-modify-write with an mtime optimistic lock: aborts if the file changed on the remote between read and write). Path is absolute. Accepts the aliases old_string/new_string (and file_path for path), matching the host edit tool, so either spelling works.
dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_append：Append text to a remote file (creates it when missing). Path is absolute.
dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_mkdir：Create a remote directory (mkdir -p semantics, all levels). Path is absolute.

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_remove：Delete a remote file (or an empty directory). recursive=true removes a directory tree (bounded). Path is absolute. This is destructive — the agent should confirm intent before calling.
dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_move：Rename or move a remote file/directory (SFTP rename, same filesystem). Paths are absolute.

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_exec：Run a shell command on the remote host. Use for anything that is not reading a file (build, test, grep, etc). Output is capped. Runs in the current remote workspace by default; pass cwd to run elsewhere. pty=true helps interactive commands (sudo prompts, REPLs); env sets environment variables. timeoutMs (1000-600000) overrides the machine-wide commandTimeoutMs for this call only. A command that outlives its timeout is MOVED TO A BACKGROUND JOB instead of being killed (pass promoteOnTimeout=false to kill it instead); run_in_background=true returns immediately with a job id. Background jobs are read with job_output and stopped with job_kill.

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_search：Search remote files for a pattern. POSIX remotes try `rg` then `grep -R` first; Windows and fallbacks use a portable SFTP walk. Honors ignore rules. Returns matching file:line rows; output is capped. Search is bounded (maxEntries/maxDurationMs) and can be cancelled: on a very large tree it returns partial results marked TRUNCATED instead of running indefinitely.

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_download：Download a single remote file over SFTP into the local mirror of the current workspace (or to an explicit local path). Use when you need the actual file content locally, not just its text. Streams to disk (fastGet).

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_upload：Upload a local file over SFTP to a path on the remote host (creating parent directories if needed). Use to push a local file directly, without a full rw_push of the whole mirror.

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_forward：Manage SSH port forwards. Direction "local" listens on 127.0.0.1:<listenPort> on THIS machine and forwards connections through SSH to <targetHost>:<targetPort> on the remote. Direction "reverse" asks the REMOTE to listen on 127.0.0.1:<listenPort> and pipes connections back to <targetHost>:<targetPort> on this machine. Call with a listenPort to create+start; with remove=true to delete.

dsh-remote 提供工具 rw_disconnect：Close this session's SSH connection to its remote host, releasing the persistent pool. Useful to rotate a connection or after a long idle. Sessions bound to other machines keep their own connections.

dsh-remote README · dsh-remote：维护多台 SSH 机器，然后在「选择工作区」时选一个**远程工作区**（或**本地工作区**），Agent 就能在不离开 harness 的情况下直接操作——列文件、读代码、在远程主机上跑构建/命令，并把远程目录镜像成一个真实的本地工作区对象。

DSH 的 Web 界面刻意只监听 `127.0.0.1`（CLI 为安全拒绝 `--host 0.0.0.0`）。本插件反过来：**由你主动连出**到你维护的机器，选一个工作区，然后通过 DSH 原生的工作区 + 文件流来工作——**不改动 `dsh-workspace` 核心**。

反过来也成立：**你可以把远端那台机器的 DSH 网页界面，当成本机浏览器里的一个页面打开**——同样不需要在远端开放任何端口（详见 [在本地打开远程机器上的 DSH 界面](#在本地打开远程机器上的-dsh-界面)）。远端 dsh 需要你先装好（插件不再代装）。

dsh-remote README · 功能：- **21 个模型工具**（便于复制/检索）：`rw_info`、`rw_connect`、`rw_machines`、`rw_pick_workspace`、`rw_list_dir`、`rw_stat`、`rw_read_file`、`rw_write_file`、`rw_edit`、`rw_append`、`rw_mkdir`、`rw_remove`、`rw_move`、`rw_exec`、`rw_search`、`rw_download`、`rw_upload`、`rw_sync`、`rw_push`、`rw_forward`、`rw_disconnect`。
- **会话列表里区分本地/远程**（`0.8.43+`）—— 远程会话的行首有一个**绿点**，悬停显示 `user@host:port` 与远端路径；打开该会话后，标题栏还会常显一个主机标签（本地会话两者都没有）。判定只看会话 cwd 是否落在 `$DSH_HOME/remote-workspaces/…` 镜像里，所以「保存过但没在用」的机器不会给本地会话打标。
- **把远端机器的 DSH 界面挂到本机**（`0.8.36+`）—— 不用在远端开任何端口：插件主动 SSH 连过去，在远端**只监听 `127.0.0.1`** 地起一个 `dsh web`，再把端口经隧道搬回本机的一个 loopback 端口。地址带一次性登录令牌，只在本机这次跳转里用一次。
- **审计日志可以在本机直接打开** —— 面板里预览最近条目，另有「打开日志文件」「在文件夹中显示」直接调用本机程序打开那个日志（日志在运行 DSH 的机器上，浏览器打不开它）。
- **远端跨平台** —— 文件访问走 SFTP 协议层（不依赖 POSIX shell），Linux/macOS/Windows 远端都能列/读/写/搜索/同步。
- **Windows 主机** —— 自动探测平台并定位 Git Bash，命令经 `bash -s` 走 stdin 执行，不受引号/反斜杠转义困扰（`config.shell` 可指定或设 `native` 关闭）；`C:\Users\dev` 与 `/c/Users/dev` 两种写法都接受。
- **长任务异步化** —— `rw_sync`/`rw_push` 传 `async: true` 返回 `taskId`，可查询进度/结果/取消。
- **数据跟随 Harness 根目录** —— 机器清单与镜像在 `$DSH_HOME/remote-workspaces`；0.6 之前的数据首次启动自动迁移。
- **`~/.ssh/config` 是连接四字段的唯一来源**（`0.8.50+`，issue #50）—— 保存机器时

dsh-remote README · DSH 版本兼容性：同时支持 `0.1.x` 与 `0.2.x` 两条 DSH 线。DSH 会在导入 bundle **之前**校验所有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peer 范围，**任一条不匹配就整包丢弃**（没有设置页、没有 `rw_*` 工具）：

```
dsh: skipping profile bundle "dsh-remote": Error: Plugin dsh-remote@… is incompatible …
```

caret 在 `0.x` 上会锁死小版本线（`^0.1.x` 容不下 `0.2.x`，反之亦然），所以自 **0.8.29** 起改为跨线区间 `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.3.0`。**低于 0.8.29 请在升级 DSH 前先升级本插件**。

dsh-remote README · 官方 Desktop 兼容适配（实验性）：对 [DeepSeek 官方 Desktop](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的适配（以 `0.1.5-rc.2` Host 协议验证，不修改 Harness 核心）：

dsh-remote README · 快速上手：1. **连接一台机器** —— 设置 → 远程工作区：页面**直接列出 `~/.ssh/config` 里的主机**（像 VSCode Remote-SSH），点「连接」即可（= 采用 + 设为当前 + 实测延迟，结果显示在这一行上）。
   要加一台配置里没有的机器，点「打开配置文件」写一个 Host 段，再点「刷新」。已保存的机器仍可「编辑」（密码、OpenSSH 后端、远端 dsh 命令这些 ssh 配置存不下的项）。
   > **保存 ≠ 激活**：保存只是备用连接；只有「连接」（或 Agent 调 `rw_connect`）才进入会话的 remote context。
2. **选工作区** —— 连上之后会自动弹出目录选择（也可以点机器行的「选目录」）：
   - **远程** → 浏览到远程目录（或输入 `/path`）→ 「设为远程工作区」⇒ 创建并收养本地镜像工作区。
   - **本机** → 系统文件夹选择（或手输路径）→ 本地工作区。宿主没有可用系统对话框时改用插件内置浏览器。
3. **让 Agent 工作** —— 当作普通工作区使用，例如 `rw_read_file` / `rw_write_file` / `rw_edit` / `rw_exec` / `rw_search` / `rw_sync` / `rw_push` / `rw_forward`（完整列表见上文）。
dsh-remote README · 快速上手：> **Remote context 是 session 级的**：只有当前 session 的工作区是某个远程镜像时，system prompt 才注入「Remote workspace」段落；普通本地 session 不受影响，模型也不会主动调 `rw_*`。

dsh-remote README · 在本地打开远程机器上的 DSH 界面：远程机器上那个 `dsh web` 也可以**当成本机的一个页面打开**（issue #46）。方向仍然是「本地主动连出去」：

> **远端不需要开放任何端口**。DSH 刻意拒绝 `--host 0.0.0.0`（它会把远程代码执行能力暴露到网络上），
> 所以正确的做法是由本机 SSH 连过去，在远端**只监听 127.0.0.1** 地起一个 `dsh web`，
> 再把它的端口经 SSH 隧道搬回本机的一个 loopback 端口。

用法：设置 → 远程工作区 → **「远程 DSH 界面」** → 选一台机器 → **连接并打开**。
浏览器会新开一个标签页，显示的就是**那台远端机器**的完整 DSH 界面（聊天、工具树、设置都在）。

text:
dsh-remote README · 在本地打开远程机器上的 DSH 界面：- 界面地址形如 `http://127.0.0.1:3088/?token=…`。那个 token 是远端进程启动时打印的一次性凭据，
  只在**本机**的这次跳转里用一次：DSH 会把它换成 30 天有效的签名 cookie 并跳转到干净的 `/`。
  **请不要把这个带 token 的地址外发**。
- 「断开」只关隧道，**不会**杀掉远端进程（它可能是你在别处也在用的实例）；
  要连远端进程一起停，用「断开并停止远端」——它只会结束**本次由插件启动**的那个进程。
- 若远端已经在跑一个界面（比如你自己在终端里起的），可以选机器后把它的
  `http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/?token=…` 粘进输入框，点「连接已有实例」，插件不会再去启第二个。
- 远端 `dsh` 不在 SSH 登录 PATH 时，用 `webAttachCommand` 指向它的绝对路径；
  想让它别污染远端用户自己的会话/设置，用 `webAttachDshHome` 指一个临时目录。
  **按机器设**：设置 → 远程工作区 → 机器卡片 → 展开「高级」→「远端 dsh 命令」，
  填绝对路径即可（例如
  `/home/you/.nvm/versions/node/v22.19.0/bin/node /home/you/.dsh-remote/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js`）；
  留空则用全局的 `webAttachCommand`。
- 隧道跟着 SSH 连接走：连接断了界面会显示「连接已断开」，**不会**影响本机 DSH 进程；

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**`@` 能列出远程文件，但内置读文件工具打不开** —— harness 自带工具看到的是**本地镜像**，要等 `rw_sync` 下载后才有内容。读远程文件请用 `rw_read_file` 或侧栏远程文件 tab。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**远程会话里的文件链接打不开**（issue #55）—— 已修。链接被点开时 harness 会把它变成
`dsh-resource://file/session/<会话>/<路径>`，然后交给内置的文本预览去读；而那个预览读的是**本机**
文件系统，远程会话的 cwd 是**本地镜像目录**（`rw_sync` 之前是空的），所以打开只会失败。
插件现在注册了一个更高优先级的地址处理器，把这个地址按远程主机解析后用 SFTP 打开（和侧栏「远程文件」同一个编辑器）。
安全边界是保守的：只有当该会话的 cwd **确实落在某个镜像目录里**、且镜像表已加载时才接管，
本地会话与页面刚加载的那一瞬间仍然走内置预览 —— 不会把本地文件误当成远程文件。
两个仍然开不了的情况会给出明确提示而不是空白页：链接指向的是**绝对**远端路径之外无法映射的地址，
或该会话的工作区不是一个远程镜像目录。
远程会话里的 `.md`/`.markdown` 同样走这条 SFTP 链路并在标签里预览（issue #74）。以前为了保住内置 Markdown 渲染把它们交回去（issue #64），但那个预览读的是本地镜像，文件还没 `rw_sync` 时就是 `ENOENT`。现在预览的是远端内容，用宿主自带的 Markdown 渲染；宿主没有该组件时才显示源码。本地会话仍然走内置预览。图片在侧栏远程文件树里直接内联显示 png/jpg/gif/webp/svg/bmp（issue #66，>2MB 退回下载按钮）。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**SFTP 操作一旦超时就永远卡死**（issue #65）—— 已修（0.8.52+）。旧版里一次撞满 20s 超时的 SFTP 操作会把
该机器在本进程内的全部 SFTP 工具拖到永久超时（`rw_exec` 却正常），只能断连重连。现在超时即置死该通道、
后续请求立即失败；native 后端连续两次超时会废弃整条连接重新握手，openssh 后端会重建 sftp 子进程——
一次网络抖动不再需要用「断开重连」来收场。顺带，`rw_edit` 改成了「临时文件 + rename」原子写，
写一半超时不会再把远端文件截成 0 字节，原文件的权限位也会保留。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**远程操作受不受本机 sandbox 约束？**（0.8.54+）—— 受。以前不受：本机会话有 `ctx.sandboxPolicy`
（read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access），而 `rw_*` 工具在远端执行**完全没有策略**，
于是一个 read-only 会话照样能改任意一台可达机器上的任意文件——沙箱没有被绕过，它对另一台机器根本
没有发言权。现在插件在**工具边界**套用同一套已解析的模式：

- `read-only`：拒绝远端写入、拒绝跑命令、拒绝开端口转发（读和连接仍可用，否则连机器都看不了）；
- `workspace-write`：远端写入必须落在工作区根之内（按路径围栏），命令与转发放行；
- `danger-full-access`：全放行。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：为什么是工具层围栏而不是 `ctx.sandbox.confine()`：后者的语义是「把 argv 包起来在**本机** spawn」，
而我们的进程跑在 SSH 通道的另一端——核心文档自己也写明「远端执行会**替换**周边 capability seam」。
所以拒绝时抛出的是**官方同形状**的 `FS_SANDBOX_DENIED`（带 `[sandbox: …]` 与升级提示），模型的
升级重试路径不受影响。

**威胁模型要讲清楚**：这是**遏制，不是安全边界**（与官方 `dsh-fs-sandbox` 文件头的口径一致）。
路径按字典比较，远端机上的符号链接与 TOCTOU 可以绕过；一旦 bash 跑起来，它用的是该用户自己的权限。
它真正买到的，是「受限会话不会**误**改工作区外的远端文件，且 read-only 会话不会偷偷跑命令」。
需要硬边界的部署，请在**远端那一侧**做（容器、按用户隔离、文件系统 ACL）。
不想用可设 `remoteSandbox: 'off'`（或 `'inherit'` 之外的值显式指定某一模式）。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**密钥库写不进去时，密码会明文落盘吗？**（0.8.54+）—— 默认**不会**。以前系统密钥库失败
（keychain 锁着 / 缺 secret-tool / Windows DPAPI 缺程序集）会**回退明文**写进 `machines.json` 并
给个警告——你本来要的是加密，结果反而更不安全，而「密钥库正好坏了」恰恰是最不容易注意到的时候。
现在默认 `credentialFallback: 'refuse'`：**不保存**该密码，机器照常保存但没有凭据，界面明确报出
密钥库失败原因。想要旧行为（宁可明文也要能连）就设 `credentialFallback: 'plain'`。
主动关掉加密（`backend: 'plain'`）不受影响，那本来就是明文。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**机器多了怎么不选错？**（0.8.54+）—— 给机器打**分组标签**：`environment`（prod/staging…）、
`location`（shanghai/gpu-lab…）、`description`、`tags`（一组自由标签）。它们纯粹是标签，不改变任何
连接行为。`rw_machines` 支持按这些维度筛选（维度之间 AND，标签之间 OR）：
`rw_machines(environment="prod", tags="gpu")`。筛不到时会列出**当前有哪些分组**，省得你猜标签拼法。
设置页同样可以编辑。机器一多，「选对机器」就从记性变成了筛选。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**多级跳板机怎么办？**（0.8.54+）—— 支持**多跳链路**（等价 OpenSSH 的 `ProxyJump a,b,c`）：
跳板机自己也可以带 `proxy`，链路从**最远一跳**往里建，每一跳都通过上一跳已建立的连接拨号。
两个关键约束：**凭据不跨跳继承**（绝不把目标机的私钥递给中间机——既通常没被授权，也等于把不该给的
秘密给了它）；链路深度超过 8 跳会明确报错，用来把**配置成环**变成一条清晰的错误，而不是无限递归。
每一跳可以自带 `privateKeyPath` / `useAgent` / `hostKeyMode`，没写就沿用操作者自己的 ssh 环境。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**能在 DSH 里直接开一个远端终端吗？**（0.8.54+）—— 能，**内嵌 PTY 终端**。`rw_exec` 是「跑一条命令
就关」，没有 PTY、stdin 也回不去，所以 `vim`、`top`、`sudo` 提示符、全屏 TUI 都用不了。
现在 `pool.shell()` 打开一条**持久的 PTY 通道**，终端会话归宿主所有：关掉浏览器不会杀掉远端 shell
（写了一半的 vim 能活过刷新），每个会话有 30 分钟空闲回收、进程内最多 8 个（免得打爆远端
`MaxSessions`），插件卸载时全部挂断。

传输方式刻意做得很朴素：远端会话在**宿主**，浏览器**轮询**输出增量（输入是单独请求、立即写入，
所以打字从不排队等轮询）。这样不依赖宿主是否暴露 WebSocket 升级路径。路由是
`/dsh-remote/term/{open,input,output,resize,close,list}`，每个都先按**会话**解析绑定——
开在 A 机的终端，绑到 B 机的请求既看不到也驱动不了。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**机器换了 IP / 用户名，工作区要全部重建吗？**（issue #67）—— 不用（0.8.52+）。在设置页编辑该机器的新
地址并保存，或 `rw_connect(machineId=…, host=…, username=…, port=…)` 同传新地址：该机器名下所有工作区
镜像会**原地重绑**（改写镜像的 `.dsh-remote-meta.json`），本地内容保留、无需重新同步，保存后会提示重绑了
几个镜像。镜像目录名不会跟着改（活 session 的 cwd 在其中），目录名只是显示标签、不影响连接。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**远程会话看不到工作区的 AGENTS.md**（issue #68）—— 已修（0.8.52+）。核心的指令加载只认本地文件系统，
而远程会话的 cwd 是本地镜像，远端仓库的 AGENTS.md 以前永远进不了模型上下文。现在 `rw_pick_workspace`
成功时会对远程工作区做浅扫（根 + 向下 ≤2 层，只匹配 `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`），把命中的文件按三向安全
规则同步进本地镜像（根级文件由此进入核心自己的注入链路，与本地会话一致），并把路径+标题索引渲染进
system prompt，提示模型编辑前用 `rw_read_file` 阅读嵌套层的指令。全树递归扫描与插件侧全文注入都**刻意
不做**（前者会扫穿多项目根目录，后者会与核心的注入管线并行打架）。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**读了远程子目录的文件，子目录里的 AGENTS.md 会自动进上下文吗？**（issue #71）—— 会（0.8.53+）。
#68 只修了静态部分（工作区浅扫 + 索引行）；动态部分当时还断着，原因是核心的增量注入只认
`read`/`write`/`edit` 且只认 `file_path` 参数，而 `rw_read_file` 名字和参数都对不上，且它做作用域
扩展时用的是**本地**路径——远程绝对路径映射不到镜像 cwd，三个断点任一都足以让注入永不发生。
现在插件自己在 `tools/result` 里接 `rw_*` 文件触碰，取「被访问目录 → 工作区根」的**整条目录链**
（不是最近一层，与本地会话一致：读 `a/b/c.ts` 会同时收 `a/AGENTS.md` 和 `a/b/AGENTS.md`），逐层
`stat` 后把当前内容合成**一条** user message 注入。几个关键边界：cwd 自己那层不重扫（核心 baseline
已覆盖，所以读工作区根下的文件不触发任何额外扫描）；按内容摘要 per-session 去重，同内容只注入一次；
远端修改后下次触碰即重新注入；注入过的文件被删除会发一条「已移除」提示；单次注入有 16 KB 预算；
机器离线时整条链路静默降级，既不挂工具调用也不挂 prompt 组装。注入消息用插件自己的
`source.kind`（`dsh-remote-instructions`），核心的状态机只认领它自己的 `agent-instructions`，两条
注入路径不会互相打架。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**`rw_exec` 能像内置 shell 那样自定义超时/取消/转后台吗？**（issue #70）—— 能（0.8.53+）。
底层 `pool.exec` 本来就支持 `timeoutMs` 与 `AbortSignal`，缺的是接线，现在补齐三件事：
① `timeoutMs` 参数（clamp 到 1000–600000，缺省仍用 `commandTimeoutMs`，超时文案打印**实际生效**的值，
不会印错成配置值）；② `exec.signal` 透传给 `pool.exec`——点「停止」会真的 SIGTERM 掉远端进程并立即
返回，不用再等满超时；③ `run_in_background: true` 立即返回 job id（用现成的 `job_output` 读、
`job_kill` 停），以及超时**转后台**而非直接杀（`promoteOnTimeout`，默认开）。后台/转后台依赖核心的
`jobs` 服务；没有该服务的组合（最小嵌入、测试替身）自动退化为只有前台执行——即 0.8.52 的行为，
不会因此加载失败。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**远程会话里的终端还是本机的**（issue #55）—— 这是**设计如此，插件改不了**，但有等效方案。
DSH 的侧栏终端是核心功能：它的 PTY 来自**全局唯一**的 `subprocess` 服务，cwd 取会话自己的
工作区目录（远程会话就是本地镜像），插件既不能替换那个服务、也不能把核心终端重定向到 SSH。
想要「真正的远程终端」，用**「远程 DSH 界面」**（见上文）：它在本机浏览器里打开**远端机器自己**的
DSH，那个界面里的终端就跑在远端主机上，零额外配置。只想偶尔跑一条远程命令则用 `rw_exec`
（要交互式 PTY 就加 `pty: true`）。

**主机指纹变了** —— `/remote forget-key`（或设置页 → 机器 → 重新信任）。

**连接报「认证失败」** —— 检查用户名/密码/私钥路径；加密私钥要填 Passphrase；需要动态码时勾选 keyboard-interactive。

**连不上内网机器** —— 填「跳板机」主机（也可先把跳板机本身配成一台机器）。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：- **A：容器把 sshd 端口映射出来了**（例如 `docker run -p 127.0.0.1:2222:22 …`）—— 纯「跳板机」配置：
  Host 填 `127.0.0.1`、Port 填 `2222`、用户/私钥填容器里的，再把「跳板机」主机填**那台远程主机**。
  为什么这样文件就能落到容器里：`proxy` 的语义是「**在跳板机上**连 `<host>:<port>`」
  （`lib/pool.js` 的 `pclient.forwardOut(...this.config.host, this.config.port...)`），
  拿到的通道会被当成主连接自己的 transport（`opts.sock`），于是 SFTP 走的是**容器自己的 sshd** ⇒
  `rw_list_dir`/`rw_read_file`/`rw_write_file`/`rw_sync` 全部读写的都是容器内的文件。
  命令行等价写法：`rw_connect(host="127.0.0.1", port=2222, username="<容器用户>", privateKeyPath="<私钥>")`。
  要求：远程主机的 sshd 允许转发（`AllowTcpForwarding yes`，默认就是）。
- **B：容器没有暴露端口** —— 纯 `~/.ssh/config` + 系统 OpenSSH 后端，在**本机** `~/.ssh/config` 写：

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：然后 `rw_connect(host="devbox", useSshConfig=true, backend="openssh")`。
  为什么 `exec` 和文件操作**都会**进容器：`openssh` 后端把别名原样交给 `ssh`，
  自己**从不**生成 `ProxyCommand`（`lib/openssh.js` 明确不传，就是为了让 `~/.ssh/config` 说了算），
  而 `ssh -s <目标> sftp` 与 `ssh -- <目标> <命令>` 走的是同一条流 ⇒ 两者都穿过这个 ProxyCommand。
  要求：容器里有 sshd，且有 `socat`（或用支持 stdio 的 `nc`）。
  ⚠️ **Windows 上有个坑**：POSIX OpenSSH 会把 `ProxyCommand` 交给 shell 展开，**Windows 自带的 OpenSSH 9.5 不会**
  （实测它把整串按字面当成 argv）。所以在 Windows 跑本插件时，要么把 `ProxyCommand` 写成
  不含 shell 元字符的单条命令，要么把「ssh 路径」指向 Git Bash 的 `ssh.exe`。
  （另：`docker exec -i` 传二进制是否逐字节无损，我这边没有 docker 环境验证过，B 方案建议先用小文件试。）

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**企业机器只允许 GSSAPI/Kerberos（`kinit` 后 `ssh` 能进，插件进不去）** —— 在设置 → 远程工作区 → 高级配置里把「连接后端」改成 **`openssh`**（调用本机 `ssh`），并勾选「使用 ssh_config 别名」，Host 填 `~/.ssh/config` 里那个**别名**（不是 IP）。这样登录由本机 ssh 用你的 Kerberos 票据完成，且 `ProxyCommand`、`GSSAPIAuthentication` 等全部照 `~/.ssh/config` 生效 —— **配置只有 `~/.ssh/config` 一个来源**（issue #50/#51）。命令行等价写法：`rw_connect(host="<别名>", useSshConfig=true, backend="openssh")`。

**`rw_sync`/`rw_push` 报冲突** —— 两边都改过的文件会被跳过并列出（绝不静默覆盖）；手动合并后重试，或用 `force=true` 以一边为准。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**Windows 远程** —— 全部走 SFTP，不依赖 POSIX shell；中文文件用 `encoding=gbk`。

**镜像里缺目录** —— 默认 ignore 会跳过 `.git`/`node_modules` 等；在 `$DSH_HOME/remote-workspaces/.dsh-remote-ignore` 调整（gitignore 语法）。

**保存远程文件报 409** —— 打开后远端已被改动，重新读取再编辑。

**密码怎么加密保存** —— 勾选「加密保存密码」：macOS 钥匙串 / Windows DPAPI / Linux secret-tool（libsecret）；后端不可用时回退明文。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**密码框为什么是空的（星号在哪）** —— 出于安全，**任何密码都不会回传到浏览器**，所以输入框永远是空的；已经保存过密码时，输入框的占位符会显示
`••••••••（已保存，留空 = 不修改）`，下方还有一行绿字说明。留空保存 = 沿用已保存的密码，填新值 = 覆盖。passphrase 与跳板机密码同理。
机器列表里的「密码」标签也是这个含义（钥匙串里的密码同样算已保存）。

**「测试连接」用哪个密码** —— 用你眼前这份表单，但**留空的密码/私钥/passphrase 会自动沿用该机器已保存的值**，所以「编辑一台已经连上的机器 → 直接点测试」是能过的
（成功提示会注明「本次测试使用了已保存的密码」）。保存之后表单会**留在该机器上**，可以立刻点测试验证；想清空重来点「取消编辑」。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**报「缺少凭据」但你确信填过** —— 说明保存时密码没有真正落盘：勾了「加密保存密码」而系统钥匙库不可用时，插件会**拒绝**把密码写成明文并给出警告
（`credentialFallback` 默认 `refuse`）。看保存后有没有红色警告，按提示修好钥匙库再存一次，或用「测试连接」当场验证。机器没有密码/私钥/agent 时，编辑表单里会直接标黄提醒。

**报「SSH agent 不可用」** —— 该机器勾了「使用 SSH agent」，但 DSH 宿主进程里没有 `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`（Windows 默认没有 agent 服务）。启动 DSH 之前把 agent 跑起来并导出
`SSH_AUTH_SOCK`（或用 Pageant），或者取消勾选、改用密码/私钥。

**升级后插件整个不见了** —— DSH 兼容性判定丢弃了 bundle，升到 **0.8.29+** 即可（见上文「DSH 版本兼容性」）。

dsh-remote README · 常见问题 / 排查：**「远程 DSH 界面」连不上/一直转圈** —— 先确认那台机器上的 `dsh web` **本身**能起来。
两个已知坑（插件会在报错里直接点出来）：
① **dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 在 Linux 上无法启动 web**——它依赖的 `node-pty@1.1.0` 只带了
macOS/Windows 的预编译产物，**没有 `linux-x64`**，会报 `Failed to load native module: pty.node`。
升到 0.1.5-rc.2+ 即可（其 `node-pty@1.2.0-beta.15` 带 Linux 预编译）。
② **dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 不认识 `--no-open`**（该 flag 是后加的）；插件会自动去掉它重试一次，无需你处理。
如果远端 `dsh` 不在 SSH 登录 PATH 里（例如装在私有前缀），用 `webAttachCommand` 指向它的绝对路径。

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**`@` lists remote files but the built-in read tool cannot open them** — the harness's own file tools see the **local mirror**, which stays empty until `rw_sync` downloads it. Read remote files with `rw_read_file` or the sidebar remote tab.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**A file link in a remote Session does not open** (issue #55) — fixed. When a link is clicked the harness turns it into `dsh-resource://file/session/<session>/<path>` and hands it to the built-in text preview, which reads the **local** filesystem; a remote Session's cwd is a **local mirror directory** (empty until `rw_sync`), so the open simply failed. The plugin now registers a higher-priority handler for that address and opens it over SFTP through the same editor as the sidebar "Remote Files" tab. The safety rule is deliberately conservative: it takes over only when the Session's cwd is **provably inside a mirror** and the mirror registry has loaded, so local Sessions — and the instant right after a page load — keep the built-in preview and no local file is ever mistaken for a remote one. The two cases that still cannot be mapped say so instead of showing a blank page: an address with no mirror mapping, and a Session whose workspace is not a remote mirror directory.
`.md`/`.markdown` links in a remote session take the same SFTP path and preview in the tab (issue #74). They used to be handed back to the built-in Markdown renderer (issue #6

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**One SFTP timeout wedged every SFTP tool on that machine** (issue #65) — fixed (0.8.52+). A single operation hitting the 20s timeout used to poison the whole process for that machine (every later SFTP call paid its own 20s, while `rw_exec` stayed fine) until a disconnect/reconnect. Now a timeout kills the channel so later requests fail fast; the native backend tears the connection down and re-handshakes after two consecutive timeouts, and the openssh backend rebuilds its sftp child — a transient network blip no longer ends with "disconnect and reconnect". As a bonus, `rw_edit` now writes atomically (temp file + rename), so an interrupted write can no longer truncate the remote file to zero bytes, and the original permission bits are preserved.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**Are remote operations subject to the local sandbox?** (0.8.54+) — yes. They were not before: a local session has `ctx.sandboxPolicy` (read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access), while every `rw_*` tool ran remote operations with NO policy at all — so a read-only session could still mutate any file on any reachable host. The sandbox was not bypassed; it simply had no say over a different machine. The plugin now applies the same resolved mode at the TOOL boundary:

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：Why a tool-layer fence rather than `ctx.sandbox.confine()`: the latter wraps argv for a spawn on THIS machine, while our process runs on the far side of an SSH channel — the core docs say so themselves ("remote execution replaces the surrounding capability seam"). A denial therefore carries the OFFICIAL `FS_SANDBOX_DENIED` shape (with the `[sandbox: …]` marker and the escalation hint), so the model's escalation path still works.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**The threat model, stated plainly**: this is CONTAINMENT, not a security boundary (the same wording the official `dsh-fs-sandbox` header uses). Paths are compared lexically, so symlinks and TOCTOU inside the remote host can escape, and once bash runs it holds that user's own privileges. What it does buy: a confined session can no longer change remote files outside its workspace BY ACCIDENT, and a read-only session cannot quietly run commands. Deployments needing a hard boundary must confine on the REMOTE side (containers, per-user accounts, filesystem ACLs). Set `remoteSandbox: 'off'` to disable the fence.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**Does a password land in plaintext when the keychain fails?** (0.8.54+) — by default, no. Previously a failed secure-store write (locked keychain / missing secret-tool / Windows DPAPI without the assembly) fell back to PLAINTEXT in `machines.json` with a warning — you asked for encryption and got something less safe than if you had not asked, and a broken keychain is exactly when nobody notices. The default is now `credentialFallback: 'refuse'`: the password is NOT saved, the machine is still saved without a credential, and the UI reports the store failure. Set `credentialFallback: 'plain'` for the legacy behaviour. Turning encryption off explicitly (`backend: 'plain'`) is unaffected.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**How do I stop picking the wrong machine once I have many?** (0.8.54+) — give machines GROUP LABELS: `environment` (prod/staging…), `location` (shanghai/gpu-lab…), `description`, and `tags` (free-form). They are pure labels and change no connection behaviour. `rw_machines` filters on them (AND across dimensions, OR within a tag list): `rw_machines(environment="prod", tags="gpu")`. An empty result lists the groups that DO exist, so you never have to guess a spelling. The settings page edits them too. Past a dozen machines, "pick the right host" stops being a memory problem.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**What about multi-level bastions?** (0.8.54+) — **multi-hop chains** are supported (OpenSSH `ProxyJump a,b,c` semantics): a bastion may carry its own `proxy`, and the chain is built from the FARTHEST hop inward, each hop dialed through the already-open connection to the previous one. Two constraints matter: credentials do NOT inherit across hops (the target's private key is never presented to an intermediate host — it is usually not authorized there, and handing it over would leak a secret that host should never see), and a chain deeper than 8 hops is reported as an error, which turns a config CYCLE into a clear message instead of unbounded recursion. Each hop may carry its own `privateKeyPath` / `useAgent` / `hostKeyMode`.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**Can I open a remote terminal inside DSH?** (0.8.54+) — yes: an **embedded PTY terminal**. `rw_exec` runs one command and closes — no PTY, no stdin once the writer returns — so `vim`, `top`, a `sudo` prompt or any full-screen TUI is impossible. `pool.shell()` now opens a PERSISTENT PTY channel, and terminal sessions are host-owned: closing the browser does not kill the remote shell (a half-finished vim survives a reload), each session is reclaimed after 30 idle minutes, at most 8 live per process (so a UI cannot exhaust the remote `MaxSessions`), and unloading the plugin hangs up every one of them.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：The transport is deliberately boring: the remote session lives on the HOST and the browser POLLS for output deltas (input is a separate request written immediately, so typing never waits for the poll cadence). That avoids depending on whether the host exposes a WebSocket upgrade path. The routes are `/dsh-remote/term/{open,input,output,resize,close,list}`, and each resolves the binding from the SESSION first — a terminal opened on host A can be neither seen nor driven by a request bound to host B.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**The machine's IP / username changed — must every workspace be recreated?** (issue #67) — no (0.8.52+). Edit the machine's new address on the settings page and save, or call `rw_connect(machineId=…, host=…, username=…, port=…)` with the new address: every workspace mirror bound to that machine is **rebound in place** (its `.dsh-remote-meta.json` is rewritten) — local content is kept, no re-sync needed, and the save response says how many mirrors were rebound. The mirror directory name does not follow (live Sessions hold cwd paths inside it); the name is a display label only and does not affect connectivity.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**Remote Sessions could not see the workspace AGENTS.md** (issue #68) — fixed (0.8.52+). The core instruction loader only knows the local filesystem, and a remote Session's cwd is the local mirror, so the remote repo's AGENTS.md never reached the model's context. Now, when `rw_pick_workspace` succeeds, the remote workspace gets a shallow scan (root + at most two levels down, matching `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` only); the found files are synced into the local mirror under a three-way guard (root-level copies thus enter the core's own injection path, exactly like a local Session), and an index of paths + headings is rendered into the system prompt, telling the model to read nested instruction files with `rw_read_file` before editing. Full-tree recursion and plugin-side full-text injection are deliberately **not** done (the former would scan through multi-project roots; the latter would run a second injection pipeline in parallel with the core's).

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**Does reading a file in a remote subdirectory pull that subdirectory's AGENTS.md into context?** (issue #71) — yes (0.8.53+). #68 fixed only the static half (workspace shallow scan + index line); the dynamic half was still broken, because the core's incremental injection recognizes only `read`/`write`/`edit` with a `file_path` argument — `rw_read_file` matches on neither name nor argument — and it expands scopes using LOCAL paths, so a remote absolute path maps onto no mirror cwd. Any one of those three gaps was enough to stop the injection from ever happening. The plugin now hooks `rw_*` file touches itself on `tools/result`, takes the WHOLE ancestor chain from the touched directory up to the workspace root (not just the deepest level, matching local Sessions: reading `a/b/c.ts` brings in both `a/AGENTS.md` and `a/b/AGENTS.md`), stats each level, and injects the current contents as ONE user message. Boundaries that matter: the cwd's own level is not re-scanned (the core baseline covers it, so reading a file directly in the workspace root triggers no extra scan); delivery is deduplicated per session by content digest, so the same content i

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**Can `rw_exec` take a per-call timeout, be cancelled, and move to the background like the built-in shell?** (issue #70) — yes (0.8.53+). The transport (`pool.exec`) already supported `timeoutMs` and `AbortSignal`; what was missing was the wiring, and all three pieces are now in place: (1) a `timeoutMs` argument (clamped to 1000-600000, defaulting to `commandTimeoutMs`) whose timeout message prints the value ACTUALLY APPLIED rather than the config value; (2) `exec.signal` is forwarded, so pressing "stop" really SIGTERMs the remote process and returns at once instead of waiting out the timeout; (3) `run_in_background: true` returns a job id immediately (read with the existing `job_output`, stop with `job_kill`), and a command that outlives its timeout is PROMOTED to a background job instead of being killed (`promoteOnTimeout`, on by default). Background execution and promotion need the core `jobs` service; a composition without it (minimal embedding, test double) degrades to foreground-only execution — the 0.8.52 behaviour — rather than failing to load.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**The terminal in a remote Session is still the local one** (issue #55) — that is **by design, and a plugin cannot change it**, but there is an equivalent: DSH's sidebar terminal is core, its PTY comes from the **context-global** `subprocess` service, and its cwd is the Session's own workspace directory (the local mirror for a remote Session). A plugin can neither replace that service nor retarget the core terminal onto SSH. For a **genuine remote terminal** use the "Remote DSH Web UI" (above): it opens the **remote machine's own** DSH in this browser, and that interface's terminal runs on the remote host, with no extra configuration. To run a single remote command instead, use `rw_exec` (add `pty: true` for an interactive PTY).

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**Host key changed** — `/remote forget-key` (or Settings → machine → trust again).

**"Authentication failed"** — check the username/password/key path; fill in the passphrase for an encrypted key; enable keyboard-interactive when the host requires OTP.

**Cannot reach an internal machine** — set a jump host (or add the bastion as its own machine first).

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**The host only allows GSSAPI/Kerberos (`ssh` works after `kinit`, the plugin does not)** — in Settings → 远程工作区 → Advanced, switch **Backend** to `openssh` (drive the local `ssh`) and tick "use a ~/.ssh/config alias", with Host set to the **alias** in `~/.ssh/config` (not the IP). The login is then performed by your local ssh with your Kerberos ticket, and `ProxyCommand`, `GSSAPIAuthentication` etc. all apply per `~/.ssh/config` — **one source of truth for the configuration** (issues #50/#51). Command-line equivalent: `rw_connect(host="<alias>", useSshConfig=true, backend="openssh")`.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**Can a docker container on the remote host be the workspace?** (issue #56) — Yes, and **no plugin change is needed**. There is no container-specific code anywhere in the plugin, yet the two configurations below already cover the request. Pick by whether the container **publishes a port**:

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：- **A: the container maps its sshd** (e.g. `docker run -p 127.0.0.1:2222:22 …`) — a plain "jump host" configuration: Host `127.0.0.1`, Port `2222`, the container's user/key, and the **remote host** as the jump host. Why the files really land in the container: `proxy` means "connect to `<host>:<port>` **as resolved by the bastion**" (`lib/pool.js`: `pclient.forwardOut(...this.config.host, this.config.port...)`), and the resulting channel becomes the main connection's own transport (`opts.sock`), so SFTP rides the **container's** sshd — `rw_list_dir`/`rw_read_file`/`rw_write_file`/`rw_sync` all read and write container files. Command-line equivalent: `rw_connect(host="127.0.0.1", port=2222, username="<container user>", privateKeyPath="<key>")`. Requires `AllowTcpForwarding` on the remote sshd (the default).
- **B: the container publishes nothing** — pure `~/.ssh/config` plus the system-OpenSSH backend, on **your** machine:

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：```sshconfig
Host devbox
    HostName devbox.invalid
    User dev
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：then `rw_connect(host="devbox", useSshConfig=true, backend="openssh")`. Why **both** commands and file operations reach the container: the `openssh` backend hands the alias to `ssh` verbatim and deliberately never emits its own `ProxyCommand` (`lib/openssh.js` omits it so that `~/.ssh/config` decides), while `ssh -s <dest> sftp` and `ssh -- <dest> <cmd>` travel the same stream. Requires an sshd inside the container plus `socat` (or an `nc` that speaks stdio).
  ⚠️ **A Windows caveat**: POSIX OpenSSH shell-expands `ProxyCommand`, but **Windows' own OpenSSH 9.5 does not** (measured: it passes the whole string through as literal argv). So on a Windows host either keep the `ProxyCommand` a single command with no shell metacharacters, or point "ssh path" at Git Bash's `ssh.exe`. (Also: whether `docker exec -i` carries binary data byte-for-byte is unverified here — no docker on this machine — so try a small file with B first.)

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**`rw_sync`/`rw_push` reports conflicts** — files changed on both sides are skipped and listed (never silently overwritten); merge manually and retry, or pass `force=true`.

**Windows remotes** — everything goes over SFTP, no POSIX shell needed; read Chinese files with `encoding=gbk`.

**A directory is missing from the mirror** — the default ignore rules skip `.git`/`node_modules` and similar; adjust `$DSH_HOME/remote-workspaces/.dsh-remote-ignore` (gitignore syntax).

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**Saving a remote file returns 409** — the remote file changed after you opened it; re-read and edit again.

**How are passwords stored?** — tick "encrypt password": macOS Keychain / Windows DPAPI / Linux secret-tool (libsecret); falls back to plaintext when unavailable.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**Why is the password box empty (where are the stars)?** — No secret is ever sent back to the browser, so the input stays empty; when a password IS saved its placeholder reads
`•••••••• (saved — leave blank to keep)` with a hint underneath. Saving with an empty box keeps the stored password; typing a new value replaces it. Same for the private-key
passphrase and the jump-host password. The password badge in the machine row means exactly this (a keychain-stored password counts as saved).

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**Which password does "Test connection" use?** — The form in front of you, but a blank password / key / passphrase **falls back to the value saved for that machine**, so
"edit a machine that already connects → click test" now works (the success line says the saved password was used). After saving, the form stays bound to that machine so you can
test immediately; press "Cancel edit" to start over.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**"No credentials" even though you filled it in** — the password never actually landed on disk: when "encrypt password" is ticked and the OS store is unavailable the plugin
**refuses** to write plaintext and reports a warning (`credentialFallback` defaults to `refuse`). Look for the red warning after saving, fix the store and save again, or use
"Test connection" to verify on the spot. A machine with no password / key / agent is flagged in amber right inside the form.

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**"SSH agent unavailable"** — the machine has "use SSH agent" ticked but the DSH host process has no `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` (Windows has no agent service by default). Start an agent
(and export `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, or use Pageant) before launching DSH — or untick it and save a password / private key instead.

**The plugin vanished after a DSH upgrade** — DSH's compatibility check dropped the bundle; upgrade to **0.8.29+** (see "DSH version compatibility" above).

dsh-remote README · FAQ / troubleshooting：**"Remote DSH Web UI" will not connect / spins forever** — first check that `dsh web` starts on that
machine *at all*. Two known traps (the plugin names them in its error):
1. **dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 cannot start the web surface on Linux** — the `node-pty@1.1.0` it depends on ships
   macOS/Windows prebuilds but **no `linux-x64`**, so it fails with `Failed to load native module:
   pty.node`. Upgrade to 0.1.5-rc.2+ (its `node-pty@1.2.0-beta.15` ships the Linux build).
2. **dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 does not know `--no-open`** (the flag came later); the plugin drops it and retries
   once automatically, so there is nothing to do.
If the remote `dsh` is not on the SSH login PATH (a private prefix, say), point `webAttachCommand` at
its absolute path.

dsh-remote README · Safety：Giving the plugin a machine's credentials lets the agent run **shell commands as your user** on that host — only add machines you trust. Passwords live in a local file (or the OS keychain); treat them as sensitive. With `auditLog` on, every command is recorded.
